Job Title: Junior Data Scientist
Company: Smart Axiata Co Ltd
Location: Phnom Penh
Employment Type: Full Time

The Junior Data Scientist is an entry-level role focused on collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to help organizations make informed decisions. Responsibilities include cleaning and organizing datasets, developing basic models, generating reports, and visualizing data trends.
• Extract and cleanse structured and unstructured data.
• Develop end-to-end data pipeline.
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and ad-hoc analysis.
• Build data solutions based on business requirements.
• Develop predictive models.
• Improve and maintain existing solutions.
• Document business processes and knowledge management.
• Bachelor of Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Statistics, or relevant fields.
• One year of working experience or personal portfolios
• Knowledge in Data, SQL and RDMS.
• Able to write quality code in Python.
• Basic understanding of Data Science, Data Mining, Machine Learning, and Descriptive Statistics.
